book.book519.description: A tale of two sisters, romantic engagements, quarrels, and the difficulty of making sensible and sensual choices in matters of love and marriage of course. Austen's delightful wit and sharp characterizations are great as ever in this all-time classic.
book.book520.title: Sister Outsider
book.book520.author: Audre Lorde
book.book520.description: A collection of boundary-breaking essays and speeches in which author Audre Lorde negotiates her complex identity as a Black woman, lesbian, poet, activist, cancer survivor, mother, and feminist.
book.book521.title: Starstruck; (Deluxe Edition)
book.book521.author: Elaine Lee & Michael Kaluta
book.book521.description: It’s a tough galaxy out there, but somebody's gotta live in it, and it might as well be YOU! The brilliant, feminist, sci-fi play turned graphic novel that you may not have heard of yet.
book.book522.title: Stormbreaker
book.book522.author: Anthony Horowitz
book.book522.description: Ever dreamt of becoming a teenage spy for MI6 and uncovering a nefarious plot? The plot may be a little ridiculous but you probably won't care as you race along this thrilling first entry in the Alex Rider series.
book.book523.title: Sula
book.book523.author: Toni Morrison
book.book523.description: The story of the friendship between two young Black girls and the conflicting paths that their lives take them on. Read on as their opposing personalities affect the town in a tale about defying social norms, resentment and reconciliation.
book.book524.title: The Sunlit Man
book.book524.author: Brandon Sanderson
book.book524.description: Nomad has been jumping between different worlds to stay ahead of his pursuers. But with his diminished powers, he is trapped on a planet where the sun's intensity will kill, and finds himself caught up in a struggle between a despotic ruler and the defiant rebels.
book.book525.title: Supernova; Renegades #3
book.book525.author: Marissa Meyer
book.book525.description: The Renegades' greatest enemy is alive, a danger once more to Gatlon City. In this thrilling conclusion to the Renegades , Adrian and Nova struggle to protect those they love, all while keeping secrets from one another. When the dust settles, who will be left standing?
book.book526.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
book.book526.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book.book526.description: Join the brilliant detective and his loyal companion on thrilling investigations as they unravel mysteries and outwit criminals in 12 legendary tales.
book.book527.title: The Book of Tea
book.book527.author: Okakura Kakuzo
book.book527.description: An open letter to the west, learn all about the Japanese values of Teaism and let them enrich your life. One of the great English tea classics that bridges the gap between the spritual and secular spheres of tea.
book.book528.title: The Book of the City of Ladies
book.book528.author: Christine de Pizan
book.book528.description: Guided by three allegorical figures, a woman builds a symbolic city with walls protecting women from slander and misogyny, celebrating their courage, wisdom, and achievements - radically ahead of its time in 15th-century Europe.
book.book529.title: Book of Yokai ; Mysterious Creatures of Japanese Folklore
book.book529.author: Michael Dylan Foster & Shinonome Kijin
book.book529.description: Yokai is a shorthand for all fantastical beings and supernatural phenomena in Japanese stories. This folkloric encyclopaedia is filled with their origins and meanings.
book.book530.title: The Canterbury Tales
book.book530.author: Geoffrey Chaucer
book.book530.description: Twenty-four stories told by twenty-four pilgrims as they travel to Canterbury Cathedral. Who can tell the most enthralling one and win a free meal at the Tabard Inn? This classic piece of English literature has been thought to have popularized the language in mainstream literature, but was it ever finished?
book.book531.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
book.book531.author: Alexandre Dumas
book.book531.description: In this epic tale of revenge, redemption, and exquisite French drama, a betrayed lover returns to the Parisian high society in search of sweet revenge.
book.book532.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
book.book532.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
book.book532.description: An unlikely band of heroes must go on a quest to destroy an evil ring once and for all. Their journey through Tolkien's vibrant fantasy world has become part of the foundation of modern fantasy literature.
book.book533.title: The Girl Who Played with Fire
book.book533.author: Stieg Larsson
book.book533.description: This book must be one of the darkest Nordic crime thrillers out there. Still, Larsson manages to sneak in moments of kindness and allyship that make this brutal revenge epos just barely possible to endure.
book.book534.title: The Green Ember; Book 1
book.book534.author: S.D. Smith & Zach Franzen
book.book534.description: Forced to flee their home, siblings Heather and Picket come to a hidden refuge where each rabbit trains their gifts to bring about a Mended Wood. Kids will love this series with its brave characters and themes of found family. Rabbits with swords!
book.book535.title: The Green Mile
book.book535.author: Stephen King
book.book535.description: The heart-wrenching story of a death-row inmate with magical abilities. Prepare for a sordid tale of a corrupt and cruel institution and of the mouse that survived it all.
book.book536.title: Greenglass House; Book 1
book.book536.author: Kate Milford & Jaime Zollars
book.book536.description: Milo has plans to exclusively munch on cookies and read books during his winter holidays. But thanks to a snow storm, his parents' inn fills with guests, all strangely invested in the story of their house. A locked room mystery and a treasure hunt, with a surprise twist!
book.book537.title: The Gunslinger
book.book537.author: Stephen King
book.book537.description: The last gunslinger's treacherous search for his ancient adversary leads him across an alternate reality Old West. A path full of monsters, demons and sacrifice lead to his ultimate destination: The Dark Tower.
book.book538.title: The House with a Clock in Its Walls
book.book538.author: John Bellairs
book.book538.description: A ticking time-clock threatens to destroy the world. A newbie and a local boy team up to stop the magical doomsday plot. Join them in this illustrated romp full of black magic, ghosts and derring-do.
book.book539.title: How Did Whales Get So Big?; An Other Curious Questions about Animals, Nature, Geology and Planet Earth
book.book539.author: MinuteEarth
book.book539.description: Are you a child who can't stop asking questions like, "Why did my hamster eat her babies?" Try this kid-friendly encyclopaedia! Filled with stick-figure illustrations and rigorous research., this STEM book is perfect for answering even the most curious kid's questions.
book.book540.title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
book.book540.author: C. S. Lewis
book.book540.description: In this delightful classic siblings stumble upon a magical world through an ordinary wardrobe, where talking animals and a wicked witch await.
book.book541.title: Listen for the Lie
book.book541.author: Amy Tintera
book.book541.description: Lucy doesn't want to be on a podcast about her best friend's murder. Her memory from that night is sketchy at best, and the town has already decided who's guilty. But true crime podcaster Ben is both persistent and attractive. Unputdownable and spicy!
book.book542.title: The Lost Continent
book.book542.author: C. J. Cutcliffe Hyne
book.book542.description: Classic fantasy meets greek mythology in this 1972 retelling of the legend of Atlantis. A heroic warrior priest is all that stands between an avaricious empress and the end of an era.
book.book543.title: The Odyssey
book.book543.author: Homer, transl. by Knox & Fagles
book.book543.description: A legendary Greek epos about a perilous journey home, with many mythical roadblocks along the way. Good thing, our protagonist is smart as a whip, and nobody is able to stop him.
book.book544.title: Oh, Mary!
book.book544.author: Cole Escola
book.book544.description: In this play, all Mary Todd Lincoln wants to do is star in a cabaret and drink, but instead she is forced to stay cooped up in Washington, DC, while her husband deals with the Civil War. Desperate to distract her, Abe hires an acting coach to give her lessons on the stage
book.book545.title: Olivetti
book.book545.author: Allie Millington
book.book545.description: When its human family is in crisis, a vintage typewriter breaks the rules to communicate what they most need to remember. A heartfelt and beautiful middle-grade book!
book.book546.title: The Outsider
book.book546.author: Stephen King
book.book546.description: The terrifying Outsider stalks Flint City, committing heinous crimes. Tag along a rag-tag team of heroes who take it upon themselves to deal with this nightmare in classic Stephen King fashion.
book.book547.title: The Poetry of Architecture
book.book547.author: John Ruskin
book.book547.description: Perhaps the origins of cottage core? John Ruskin will take you on a tour of his favourite cottages and villas throughout Europe. Delight in his philosophical musings about the beautiful interplay of nature and architecture.
book.book548.title: Pollyanna; Book 1
book.book548.author: Eleanor H. Porter
book.book548.description: A little orphan girl with toxic positivity moves in with her cold matronly Aunt, and winds up changing the entire mood of their small town in Vermont. A classic book that inspired hundreds of children to start 'gladness clubs' ( Yes, really ).
book.book549.title: The Return of the King
book.book549.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
book.book549.description: The legendary showdown between good and evil, bravery and cowardice, love and doubt in a fantasy world on the brink of collapse. In between it all are some of the most poetic character moments in writing history.
book.book550.title: The Scarecrow of Oz
book.book550.author: L. Frank Baum
book.book550.description: Return to the land of Oz and embark on a typically Ozian adventure lined with quirky characters and unlikely scenarios. Join Cap'n Bill, Trot and a magical Scarecrow as they take down dastardly King Krewl.
book.book551.title: The Shadow of the Wind
book.book551.author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
book.book551.description: He possesses the only known copy of a mysterious book by an even more mysterious author. Join Daniel on his treacherous journey to uncover the story of the book and its author in this winding neo-gothic novel.
book.book552.title: The Silent Patient
book.book552.author: Alex Michaelides
book.book552.description: A terrifying delve into the twisted mind of Alicia Berenson. What moved her to suddenly murder her husband? And will the search for the truth be too much to bear...
book.book553.title: The Snowy Day
book.book553.author: Ezra Jack Keats
book.book553.description: A young Black boy explores his neighbourhood transformed by the magic of snow. The beautiful illustrations of this charming story helped pave the way for more inclusive representation in children's literature.
book.book554.title: So Easy So Good
book.book554.author: Kylie Sakaida
book.book554.description: Packed with recipes and information on healthy eating, this cookbook draws from Kylie's expertise as a Japanese-American dietician to make cooking accessible, practical and delicious for all.
book.book555.title: Stone Butch Blues
book.book555.author: Leslie Feinberg
book.book555.description: A butch lesbian comes of age in the world of gay bars, homophobic police raids, and her complex relationship to gender. While unflinching in its depiction of homophobic violence, this book has some of the most achingly romantic prose about love you'll ever read.
book.book556.title: The Stones of Venice
book.book556.author: John Ruskin
book.book556.description: A thoroughly researched exploration of Venitian art and architecture, comprised of three groundbreaking volumes. If you have a soft spot for hard rocks, get this!
book.book557.title: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
book.book557.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
book.book557.description: In this fantastic gothic horror thriller not everything is as it seems, when a violent madman begins an escalating crime spree in London. As a lawyer begins investigating these mysterious incidents, a brilliant exploration of identities and dark urges ensues.
book.book558.title: The Two Towers
book.book558.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
book.book558.description: In this second book in Tolkien's foundational fantasy epic, the forces of evil have not been idle, and so our protagonists see themselves surrounded by evil creatures and poor advisors.
book.book559.title: The Westing Game
book.book559.author: Ellen Raskin
book.book559.description: 16 heirs must pair up to solve the mystery of eccentric millionaire Sam Westing's last will and testament, all to win his vast fortune. Puzzle along as the twist and turns of this clever case unfold.
book.book560.title: Towards a New Architecture
book.book560.author: Le Corbusier
book.book560.description: This polarizing manifesto calls for a new architecture for modern times. A foundational text to understand Corbusier's work, brutalism and mid-century architectural movements.
book.book561.title: Ugly Love
book.book561.author: Colleen Hoover
book.book561.description: He doesn't want love, and she doesn't have time for it. Sounds like a perfect arrangement with benefits, right? If only people and their hearts were so simple...
book.book562.title: Understanding Comics; The Invisible Art
book.book562.author: Scott McCloud
book.book562.description: This book makes you appreciate both creating and reading comics as a hobby even more! By going over the history of visual storytelling, it explains how design choices - often invisible to readers' eyes - affect the reading experience.
book.book563.title: The Unexpected Mrs. Pollifax; Mrs. Pollifax #1
book.book563.author: Dorothy Gilman
book.book563.description: Emily Pollifax is a widowed empty-nester who's always dreamt of becoming a spy. So at 60 years of age, she leaves her tiny apartment in New Jersey to visit Washington, and ask politely if the CIA will have her. Thus begins a hilarious and lighthearted mystery series!
book.book564.title: White Night
book.book564.author: Jim Butcher
book.book564.description: Wizard detective Harry Dresden is back in the 9th instalment of The Dresden Files. His new case takes him into Chicago's seedy underbelly as he tracks a vicious serial killer of magical practitioners.
book.book565.title: Witch Wood
book.book565.author: John Buchan
book.book565.description: The devil lurks in the Witch Wood, or so people say. A disappearing minister, a satanic cult and a ravaging plague, but what lies at the bottom of it all? Find out in this Scottish masterpiece.
book.book566.title: Z for Zachariah
book.book566.author: Robert C. O'Brian
book.book566.description: When her brother left the valley and didn't return, Ann assumed that she was the last survivor of a nuclear war. That is, until a stranger in a radiation suit appeared. Why was he here? What did he want? A thrilling tale of survival and not knowing who to trust.
book.book567.title: Zaha Hadid
book.book567.author: Zaha Hadid
book.book567.description: Concrete, light, curves! This coffee table book is packed with some of contemporary architecture's finest works by visionary architect Zaha Hadid.
book.book568.title: Adventures of A Wild Child
book.book568.author: Gina Grayson Hunt
book.book568.description: Join the escapades of a free-spirited wanderer as they navigate love, self-discovery, and countless adventures in this captivating memoir.
book.book569.title: An Explorer's Guide to Georgetown
book.book569.author: Zheng Greene
book.book569.description: Discover the secrets of Georgetown in this fun and beautifully illustrated guide. Explore its history, indulge in local cuisine, and soak up the vibrant lifestyle.
book.book570.title: An Unkindness of Ghosts
book.book570.author: Rivers Solomon
book.book570.description: On a deeply stratified spaceship, Aster uses her wit and courage to defy oppression. An afrofuturist, queer, and fiercely feminist journey.
book.book571.title: Catching Carps
book.book571.author: Nigel Carpum
book.book571.description: Reel in this absolute catch of a book, because Carpum's fishing trip is something special! Weaving together carp facts, personal philosophy, and globetrotting tales, the author shares all his wisdom.
book.book572.title: Encyclopaedia Bookstonia Vol. 1
book.book572.author: Ash Axbridge
book.book572.description: Discover a treasure trove of knowledge in this captivating encyclopaedia! From A as in Academia to C as in Crime, learn more about what makes the world of books go round.
book.book573.title: Gemology: A Study in Ruby
book.book573.author: Ellie Obsidia
book.book573.description: Unearth the secrets of the dazzling gemstones in this sparkling study of gemology. A challenging academic text from an expert of the field.
book.book574.title: The Ghost Map; A Street, a City, An Epidemic and the Hidden Power of Urban Networks
book.book574.author: Steven Johnson
book.book574.description: Two different paths converge, and between John Snow (physician) and Henry Whitehead (reverend), the source of London's 1854 cholera outbreak is chased down to a single public water pump on Broad Street.
book.book575.title: Hiking Trails in Bookston Bay
book.book575.author: Val Bomier
book.book575.description: Get lost and find yourself amidst the stunning natural beauty of Bookston Bay's secret hiking trails. Stunning coastal vistas await around every corner!
book.book576.title: Into the Sunset: The Magical West
book.book576.author: Cemal M. Fahmy
book.book576.description: Explore the mythical and exotic lands of Western Europe. This satirical travelogue lets you in on the secret wisdom and mysterious culture of the West.
book.book577.title: My Travels In East Africa
book.book577.author: Tao Ryota
book.book577.description: From Burundi to Uganda, an ageing adventurer shares his eye-opening journey through Eastern Africa, learning life's greatest lessons along the way.
book.book578.title: The Secret History of Bookstonbury
book.book578.author: H. A. Pennington
book.book578.description: An insight into the forgotten anecdotes of history, which was hugely popular in 1953 and still makes for an entertaining read. However, most of these historical "theories" have since been disproven.
book.book579.title: The Secret Island; The Secret Series #1
book.book579.author: Enid Blyton
book.book579.description: A cozy tale of four children, Mike, Peggy, Nora and their friend Jack, who escape to a "secret" island on a serene lake, where they live an unfettered life of stowing away in a willow-treehouse and foraging for their own food.
book.book580.title: Selected Stories of Anton Chekhov
book.book580.author: A. Chekhov, L. Volokhonsky & R. Pevear
book.book580.description: 30 stories from the Russian writer and playwright, famous for his painterly prose and use of foreshadowing. This collection features The Huntsman , A Boring Story , The Lady with the Little Dog (a crowd-pleaser), and Chekhov's personal favourite, The Student .
book.book581.title: Hélène
book.book581.author: St. Bookston
book.book581.description: A romantic reinterpretation of the Illiad. Hélène, a 16th-century version of Helen of Troy, has the chance to forever change the trajectory of her life and love. A historical play and a St. Bookston classic for a reason!
book.book582.title: Hello Lighthouse
book.book582.author: Sophie Blackall
book.book582.description: A Caldecott Award Winning picture book, Say hello to a lighthouse keeper and his wife, guarding the coast through the days of stormy waves and sunny skies, waiting for the arrival of their child. At the end, wave goodbye to the lighthouse on their return to the mainland.
book.book583.title: A Collection of Poems
book.book583.author: St. Bookston
book.book583.description: A collection of Saint Bookston's greatest works of poetry, including Ashen Grey , Prometheus' Regrets , and Last Breaths .
book.book584.title: A Senseless Power
book.book584.author: St. Bookston
book.book584.description: A timeless family drama by the brilliant Bookston. The three sons of a rich merchant family are vying for their powerful mother's approval. Will their quest for the matriarch's position be worth the destruction they sow on their ways to the top?
book.book585.title: On the Naturale Flora of Bookstonborough
book.book585.author: St. Bookston
book.book585.description: A taxonomy of the flora of Bookston Bay from the late 16th century. With hand-drawn illustrations by the polymath Saint Bookston.
book.book586.title: Rebecca
book.book586.author: Daphne du Maurier
book.book586.description: Our protagonist is freshly married to a rich manor lord. At her new home, expectations of a carefree married life are shattered when questions about Rebecca, the late lady of the house, arise.
book.book587.title: Carmilla
book.book587.author: J. Sheridan Le Fanu
book.book587.description: The lesbian vampire story you didn't know you needed! This classic gothic horror novel details young Laura's encounter with a new guest at her father's castle, a young woman named Carmilla.
book.book588.title: Anne of Green Gables
book.book588.author: L.M. Montgomery
book.book588.description: Anne of Green Gables is the redheaded and feisty orphan girl you can't help but love! This charming children's classic is beloved by readers of all ages around the world.
book.book589.title: Guards! Guards!
book.book589.author: Terry Pratchett
book.book589.description: If you're looking to get into the Discworld series, this 8th tale is the one to start with. (There's a lot of them!) Adventure awaits the magical lands of Ankh-Morpork, when a long-lost "noble" dragon suddenly returns and is promptly crowned King.
book.book590.title: The Haunting of Hill House
book.book590.author: Shirley Jackson
book.book590.description: In this tense horror classic, a group surrounding an "expert of the occult" are investigating the mysterious Hill House. But inside, they are awaited by more than just spooky poltergeists...
book.book591.title: Dinosaurs and other Prehistoric Life
book.book591.author: Anusuya Chinsamy-Turan
book.book591.description: A collection of over 90 prehistoric plants and animals, stunningly illustrated by Angela Rizza and Daniel Long. In this remarkable guide, readers of all ages may find their new favourite fossil!
book.book592.title: Newtonian Physics for Babies
book.book592.author: Chris Ferrie
book.book592.description: This book is the only physics guide truly written for everyone! Whether you are only months old or already retired, this cheeky picture book might make a genius out of you yet.
book.book593.title: The Adventures of Pippi Longstocking
book.book593.author: Astrid Lindgren
book.book593.description: Follow the energetic escapades of young Pippi, the girl with the red braids who lives all alone in her big colourful house with her trusty pet monkey always at her side, and who doesn't listen to what the boring adults have to say.
book.book594.title: Codename Villanelle
book.book594.author: Luke Jennings
book.book594.description: An assassin going by the codename "Villanelle" has recently appeared on the map, killing some of the most influential men in international politics. Can former MI6 agent Eve find and catch this eccentric psychopath?
book.book595.title: Coffee First, Then the World
book.book595.author: Jenny Graham
book.book595.description: We've all been on a bike, maybe even done a few long-distance rides. But Jenny Graham took it much further: She cycled around the world! This is her raw, unfiltered, and hilarious account of how she became the fastest woman to ever circumnavigate the globe on two wheels.
book.book596.title: Moominland Midwinter
book.book596.author: Tove Jansson
book.book596.description: The Moomins are lovable small creatures, invented by the Finnish illustrator, who live a peaceful life in the forest. In the 8th book of the classic children's series, little Moomintroll wakes up during winter hibernation and has to be very brave about it.
book.book597.title: The Witch Boy
book.book597.author: Molly Knox Ostertag
book.book597.description: In Aster's family, boys aren't meant to be witches, they're supposed to grow into shapeshifters. But at 13, Aster still hasn't shifted, and when his friends need help, his fascination with witchcraft might be the only thing that can help. A graphic novel for adventurous middle-grade readers.
book.book598.title: The Bookshop Book
book.book598.author: Lucy Mangan
book.book598.description: Part memoir, part love letter to children’s literature, you will revisit childhood favourites and likely find gems you missed the first time round. Ideally, read wrapped in a blanket and in a window seat if at all possible.
book.book599.title: Borne
book.book599.author: Jeff VanderMeer
book.book599.description: In a post-apocalyptic city, climate refugee Rachel adopts a surreal creature. The creature's questions hold a mirror to humanity, reflecting back the good, the bad, and the absurd. But is Borne as innocent as they seem, or merely a quiet, growing threat?
book.book600.title: Bookworm; A Memoir of Childhood Reading
book.book600.author: Jen Campbell
book.book600.description: Get a glimpse into the most unusual bookshops around the world and fall in love with their proprietor's passion for the trade. I might be biased, but if you ask me, this love letter to weird and wonderful bookshops is only missing one entry (*chrm* yours truly *chrm*).
book.book601.title: What We Don't Talk About; When We Talk About Fat
book.book601.author: Aubrey Gordon
book.book601.description: This revolutionary book aims to challenge the cultural attitudes and systemic biases behind anti-fatness and calls for a social justice movement that includes fat activism.
book.book602.title: Witch Hat Atelier; Volume 1
book.book602.author: Kamome Shirahama
book.book602.description: How can Coco ever become a witch if she was born without the gift of magic? Well, a mysterious magician might hold the missing puzzle pieces for her dreams to come true! This popular manga series promises loveable characters and a whole lot of magic.
book.book603.title: The Surgeon
book.book603.author: Tess Gerritsen
book.book603.description: A sadistic serial killer is on the loose in Boston, and evidence of his surgical skills leads investigator Rizzoli to suspect that he might be a physician. A dark and twisted thriller and the first in the popular Rizzoli & Isles crime series.
book.book604.title: The Taking of Annie Thorne
book.book604.author: C.J Tudor
book.book604.description: Joe Thorne has never gotten over his sister's disappearance and her unsettling return. As Stephen King says ( and surely Joe would agree , "sometimes, dead is better". Now he's home, back where it all went wrong, seeking answers and revenge as he confronts the past.
book.book605.title: Tasting History; Explore the Past through 4,000 Years of Recipes
book.book605.author: Max Miller
book.book605.description: Have you ever wondered what people were cooking during the Great Depression? Or did you always want to try a recipe from Ancient Rome? Max Miller was curious about the same thing, and this fun book recreates his viral cooking adventures for the page.
book.book606.title: Happily Ever After Cookbook; Original Recipes for Book Lovers
book.book606.author: Various Authors
book.book606.description: Book-inspired recipes! Need I say more? When bestselling romance authors team up with chefs to create their own dishes, you might be in for a treat! Try it at home!
book.book607.title: Cook As You Are; Recipes for Real Life, Hungry Cooks and Messy Kitchens
book.book607.author: Ruby Tandoh
book.book607.description: Sometimes, our lives just don't leave space for cooking. Or do they? These delicious recipes work for all kinds of situations, whether you need last-minute inspiration, only have one clean pot, or can't easily chop ingredients.
book.book608.title: Cook Korean!; A Comic Book with Recipes
book.book608.author: Robin Ha
book.book608.description: Most people like having visual aids in their recipes. But this book takes illustrated cooking to the next level! Enjoy this colourful and fun guide to Korean cuisine, and make cooking new recipes more fun than ever.
book.book609.title: A Cook's Tour; Global Adventures in Extreme Cuisines
book.book609.author: Anthony Bourdain
book.book609.description: Experience global culinary adventures with beloved chef Anthony Bourdain! A savoury travel memoir in search of the perfect meal.
book.book610.title: The Stonewall Reader
book.book610.author: The New York Public Library
book.book610.description: This curated anthology chronicles the Stonewall uprisings after fifty years through articles, first accounts, and more. Iconic activists and forgotten revolutionaries, who were indispensable to the gay liberation movement, tell their stories.
book.book611.title: We Are Bridges; A Memoir
book.book611.author: Cassandra Lane
book.book611.description: To come to terms with a new stage in her life, Cassandra explores what that family memory means to her. She carries on a tradition of Black Women's storytelling and history-keeping to contrast her present day with the South in the early 20th century.
book.book612.title: We Solve Murders; Book 1
book.book612.author: Richard Osman
book.book612.description: Amy is working as a bodyguard for a famous author on her private island when a body washes onshore. Thankfully, her father-in-law, Steve, is a retired police officer with plenty of free time on his hands! The first case in a series for this dynamic duo.
book.book613.title: Hawaii's Story by Hawaii's Queen
book.book613.author: Lili'uokalani
book.book613.description: Queen Lili'uokalani was the last reigning monarch of Hawai'i, before the kingdom was overthrown and annexed as a territory of the United States of America. A unique and informative autobiography.
book.book614.title: Heartless
book.book614.author: Marissa Meyer
book.book614.description: Not all fairytales have a happy ending. The Queen of Hearts is a brutal monarch. But once, she was just Catherine - young and idealistic. Shenanigans ensue when Cath meets Jest, sparking a forbidden love story where hearts are stolen, broken and freely given...
book.book615.title: Botany in a Day; The Patterns Method of Plant Identification
book.book615.author: Thomas J. Elpel
book.book615.description: Want to impress your friends and family with this great plant identification party trick? This book covers more than 100 plant families and how to spot their common features. Become a botany expert!
book.book616.title: The Boundless Sea; A Human History of the Oceans
book.book616.author: David Abulafia
book.book616.description: In this dauntingly comprehensive volume, explore humankind's relationship with the planet's greatest body of water - the ocean. This definitive work chronicles the world history of maritime empires and trade routes; while debunking long-held myths and beliefs.
book.book617.title: Boy's Life
book.book617.author: Robert R. McCammon
book.book617.description: When a boy and his father witness the aftermath of a gruesome murder, their lives become haunted by paranoia. The boy is forced to grow up quickly in a town where every friendly face becomes a potential murderer.
book.book618.title: The Boy, The Mole, The Fox and The Horse; (Book 1)
book.book618.author: Charlie Mackesy
book.book618.description: In a world where we have to navigate so much, unlikely friends often help us find our way home. So goes for the boy, the mole, the fox, and the horse, who share their life lessons along the way. With beautiful watercolour pictures, this is truly a book for all ages!
book.book619.title: Boys run the riot, Vol. 1
book.book619.author: Keito Gaku
book.book619.description: Ryo, a trans teen fed up with gender rules (especially skirts), finds freedom in fashion. Teaming up with a rebellious classmate, they start a clothing brand to express themselves beyond labels. A bold, queer and stylish manga about self-acceptance and friendship.
book.book620.title: Boys run the riot, Vol. 1
book.book620.author: Keito Gaku
book.book620.description: In volume two of this heartfelt manga, trans teen Ryo and rebel Jin have launched their DIY fashion brand Boys Run the Riot, but Ryo struggles with coming out. Can he stay true to himself and still make it in fashion?
book.book621.title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
book.book621.author: Truman Capote
book.book621.description: Holly Golightly might seem shallow and carefree, with her many suitors and piles of gifts. But as the young writer gets to know her-first out of curiosity, then attraction - he realises she's not cheap, she's priceless .
book.book622.title: The Bright Sword
book.book622.author: Lev Grossman
book.book622.description: The adventure of Collum and the oddballs of the Round Table as they seek to restore order to the kingdom after the death of King Arthur and the heroes of legend. Together, they will learn the troubled past of King Arthur and mysteries of Britain.
book.book623.title: British Boutique Hotels
book.book623.author: Gina Jackson
book.book623.description: From quiet country retreats to luxurious city stays, this pocket-sized guide is your key to Britain's best boutique hotels! A highly opinionated and indispensable companion for the discerning traveler.
book.book624.title: Brown Girl Dreaming
book.book624.author: Jacqueline Woodson
book.book624.description: An award-winning memoir-in-verse. Jacqueline uses poetry to share what it was like growing up Black during the 1960s-1970s in South Carolina and New York, including the growing joy she found in writing. A powerful, yet approachable book for middle-grade readers.
book.book625.title: The Bullet That Missed; A Thursday Murder Club Mystery #3
book.book625.author: Richard Osman
book.book625.description: Another week at Copper's Chase retirement village, another cold case for Joyce, Elizabeth, Ibrahim, and Ron to solve. A stranger from Elizabeth's past arrives to threaten her, but the Thursday Murder Club always keep their confidences and protects their own!
book.book626.title: Bury Our Bones in the Midnight Soil
book.book626.author: V.E. Schwab
book.book626.description: A sensual slow burn about immortal love and what drives us to obsession. Dark, sapphic, beautiful vampires. Yes please.
book.book627.title: A Buzz in the Meadows; The Natural History of a French Farm
book.book627.author: Dave Goulson
book.book627.description: A tale of how Goulson transformed a derelict farm into a sanctuary for plants and pollinators. Filled with humorous anecdotes and fascinating science, this book is a heartfelt plea to cherish and protect life in all its forms—especially the tiniest of creatures.
book.book628.title: Entangled Life; How Fungi Make Our Worlds, Change Our Minds & Shape Our Futures
book.book628.author: Merlin Sheldrake
book.book628.description: They can make us healthy, make us sick, make us drunk or high, or grow on our graves once we are gone. Merlin Sheldrake (what a great name) lets us in on the secrets of the fungi, the coolest lifeform on Earth.
book.book629.title: Escape from Mr. Lemoncello's Library; Mr. Lemoncello's Library #1
book.book629.author: Chris Grabenstein
book.book629.description: Kyle Keeley never met a puzzle he didn't like. So he's thrilled when a famous game maker invites him and 12 other kids to an overnight lock-in, the grand opening of the town library. In the morning, the doors are still locked. Solve the puzzles and escape the library!
book.book630.title: The Origin of Species
book.book630.author: Charles Darwin
book.book630.description: Charles Darwin's groundbreaking research on natural selection became one of the founding texts of modern biology and science. His discoveries were used to argue against a creationist belief system and created the grounds for a new study of evolution.
book.book631.title: Provence to Pondicherry; Recipes from France and Faraway
book.book631.author: Tessa Kiros
book.book631.description: Starting in Provence and following the routes of early French explorers, Kiros takes us on a  journey to discover French culinary influences in far-flung colonial destinations through an array of delicious recipes.
book.book632.title: A Psalm for the Wild-Built
book.book632.author: Becky Chambers
book.book632.description: In a beautifully futuristic world running on solar power and mutual aid, our protagonist, Dex, lives a very fulfilling life as a monk. Still, something is missing in their life, and something calls them on a journey into the wilderness.
book.book633.title: Pygmalion
book.book633.author: George Bernard Shaw
book.book633.description: Professor Henry Higgins bets he can coach a socially awkward flower seller into passing as an aristocratic lady. He doesn't expect to fall in love with her. This humorous play pokes fun at classicism in the 10th century, and was later adapted as the musical My Fair Lady .
book.book634.title: A Raisin in the Sun
book.book634.author: Lorraine Hansberry
book.book634.description: The youngers, a Black family in 1950s Chicago, await an insurance payment that could radically improve their circumstances but can't agree on how to spend it. A play about the barriers of upward mobility, housing discrimination, and the pressures to assimilate.
book.book635.title: The Royal Horticultural Society Encyclopedia of Gardening
book.book635.author: Royal Horticultural Society
book.book635.description: With this reference work, it is easier than ever to pick up gardening! Simply follow the guides, made easy with the help of over 3000 photographs, or look up any questions you might have about your plants. Guaranteed green thumb!
book.book636.title: The Ruins of Gorlan; (Ranger's Apprentice #1)
book.book636.author: John Flanagan
book.book636.description: Rangers are mysterious figures, believed to practice strange magic. But when young Will is chosen to become a Ranger's apprentice, he discovers a whole new world of secrets. And on the horizon, a fierce enemy wakes...
book.book637.title: Russians in Alaska, 1732-1867
book.book637.author: Lydia T. Black
book.book637.description: A comprehensive overview of a time when Alaska was once Russian. The harsh exploitation of people, natural resources, socioeconomic factors, and the complexity of relationships formed from this time are covered in this definitive work.
book.book638.title: Annihilation
book.book638.author: Jeff VanderMeer
book.book638.description: Why has every previous expedition into Area X ended in a horrible tragedy? And what actually hides inside the contaminated zone? Four scientists are sent to find out in this first volume of a tense cosmic horror trilogy.
book.book639.title: Anna Karenina
book.book639.author: Leo Tolstoy
book.book639.description: An emotionally-charged Russian novel about love triangles, affairs, and farming. Wish you could be the hero of your own tragic story? Ride a sad train with Anna Karenina.
book.book640.title: The Fisherman
book.book640.author: John Langan
book.book640.description: It begins as a slow, melancholy tale of two widowed fishermen in upstate New York. But this unusual horror epic quickly turns into a deeply moving and intimate nightmare that will leave you awake at night.
book.book641.title: The Sea Around Us
book.book641.author: Rachel Carson
book.book641.description: An incredible insight into the history of our oceans, their influence and power, but also their fragility, written by American marine biologist and conservationist Rachel Carson.
book.book642.title: The Sea Inside
book.book642.author: Philip Hoare
book.book642.description: A collection of anecdotes, histories, and mythologies from Philip's seemingly aimless wanderings across the world - each one, in its own way, connected to the sea, its islands, and its maritime creatures.
book.book643.title: Spirals in Time; The Secret Life and Curious Afterlife of Seashells
book.book643.author: Helen Scales
book.book643.description: Helen Scales has the perfect name for a marine biologist and wrote the perfect book for all of us who are fascinated by members of the phylum Mollusca. Explore the history of these curious sea creatures with shells.
book.book644.title: Spring Clean
book.book644.author: Sabreen Islam
book.book644.description: A soft and touching poetry collection, exploring memories both painful and nostalgic. Teaches readers the importance of a spring clean, making space to reflect on the past to see a brighter future.
book.book645.title: The Search; Avatar The Last Airbender (#4-6)
book.book645.author: Konietzko, DiMartino & Yang
book.book645.description: Finally find out what happened to Zuko's and Azula's mother in this continuation of the animated series! Aang and his friends are once again saddled up on their flying bison and are hurdled straight into another emotional and hilarious adventure.
book.book646.title: Wake; The Hidden History of Women-Led Slave Revolts
book.book646.author: Rebecca Hall & Hugo Martínez
book.book646.description: This revolutionary graphic novel uncovers the history of women who fought for their freedom on slave ships and throughout the Americas. It is a powerful exploration of resistance at the intersection of white supremacy and patriarchy.
book.book647.title: The Magic Fish
book.book647.author: Trung Le Nguyen
book.book647.description: An emotional yet hopeful YA graphic novel about the son of Vietnamese immigrants. His parents struggle with their English, so how can Tien really talk to them about what he is going through? Will they understand when he tells them he is gay?
book.book648.title: An Age of License; A Travelogue (#1)
book.book648.author: Lucy Knisley
book.book648.description: This comic is many things: a charming travel memoir about a trip through Europe, a lighthearted advice book for anyone with travel anxieties, and a book full of beautiful illustrations of cute kittens and delicious food.
book.book649.title: An Atlas of Countries that Don't Exist
book.book649.author: Nick Middleton
book.book649.description: From vast regions like Catalonia to tiny islands claimed by a single person, this book tours 50 unrecognised and largely unnoticed 'countries' - by turns hilarious, heartbreaking, and fascinating. The perfect bunny-slipper read for the armchair traveler
book.book650.title: An Experiment with an Air Pump
book.book650.author: Shelagh Stephenson
book.book650.description: On the cusp of a new century, deep in the throes of scientific discovery, one house has concealed a secret for 200 years; a literal body in the basement! This play jumps between the past and present, examining scientific ethics and dramatics.
book.book651.title: This Was Our Pact
book.book651.author: Ryan Andrews
book.book651.description: No one turns for home. No one looks back. That's the promise Ben and his friends made as they set our to follow the paper lanterns go. Eventually it's only Ben and Nathaniel on a delightfully weird and magical journey in this stunning graphic novel.
book.book652.title: Thornhill
book.book652.author: Pam Smy
book.book652.description: Mary is an orphan living at the Thornhill Institute, who tells her story in her diary. Ella, whose story is told through artful comic strips, has just moved into a street with an old, abandoned house... A dark and haunted story fit for young readers!
book.book653.title: Three Bags Full; Sheep Detective Story #1
book.book653.author: Leonie Swann & Anthea Bell
book.book653.description: A humorous murder mystery set on a hillside near Glennkill, Ireland. A flock of sheep are outraged that someone got away with murdering their shepherd, George. Can this eclectic cast of sheep detectives figure out who killed him? An absolutely baaa-tty first book.
book.book654.title: Thumbelina
book.book654.author: Hans Christian Andersen
book.book654.description: Born from a flower, tiny Thumbelina drifts past marriage-minded toads, moles, and bossy swallows, trying to find a home where she's loved, not used. A sweet fairy tale about finding where you belong.
book.book655.title: Troglobites Don't Bite
book.book655.author: Mayara Ferreira
book.book655.description: What does life look like in total darkness? It's much more busy than you would think! Get to know the most fascinating cave-dwellers: from worms to snails, spiders, crustaceans, insects, fish, amphibians, and even the occasional mammalian visitor!
book.book656.title: How Many Castles in 7 Days?
book.book656.author: Stephen Jezek
book.book656.description: Stephen is a fan of castles, and he always manages to visit one wherever he travels. On his effective quest to see the most castles in only one week, Stephen compares the Czech Republic, Thuringia, and Wales in this hilarious travelogue.
book.book657.title: How to Stop Time
book.book657.author: Matt Haig
book.book657.description: Discover immortality as it has never been explored before. A historical fantasy about finding yourself, and learning how to live by the hand of Tom Hazzard, who has been alive for barely 400 years.
book.book658.title: Dragon Ball; Volume 1
book.book658.author: Akira Toriyama
book.book658.description: The most energetic and funny adventure awaits young manga fans in this classic series. Join the super-strong Goku on a fantastical quest for the seven Dragon Balls that have the power to grant wishes!
book.book659.title: Dragonology; The Complete Book of Dragons
book.book659.author: Ernest Drake
book.book659.description: Dr Drake's quintessential guide for any budding dragonologist. Learn how to identify different dragon species, understand their biology, and live peaceably alongside them. Contains maps, specimens, and secret messages to spark the imagination!
book.book660.title: Jujutsu Kaisen; Volume 1
book.book660.author: Gege Akutami
book.book660.description: Supernatural strength, cursed objects, and occult research are becoming daily occurrences for Yuji Itadori, the high school outcast protagonist of this popular manga series. A dark adventure for teen readers!
book.book661.title: Ranma 1/2; Volume 1
book.book661.author: Rumiko Takahashi
book.book661.description: All that the teenager Ranma Saotome wants to do is train in martial arts. But a cursed spring queers his pitch, so to speak, because now, every time he is splashed with water, he changes into a girl. The beginning of a sweet and romantic manga series.
book.book662.title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint; Volume 1
book.book662.author: singNsong & UMI
book.book662.description: This epic manwha series brings a whole new twist on the reverse-isekai trope! Dokja Kim is the only reader of an obscure online novel. So when the dystopic events of the story suddenly occur in real life, he might be the only one who can still rewrite fate!
book.book663.title: On the Banks of Plum Creek; (Little House, Book 4)
book.book663.author: Laura Ingalls Wilder
book.book663.description: Laura and her family leave their house on the prairie for Plum Creek in Minnesota. During the day, Laura and Mary go to school, do chores, and go fishing. At night, Pa's fiddle sings them to sleep. Fourth in a classic series perfect for little pioneers!
book.book664.title: Sailor Moon; Volume 1
book.book664.author: Naoko Takeuchi
book.book664.description: You know her, you love her: Usagi Tsuniko might be a bit sensitive and clumsy, but when her friends are in trouble, she turns into THE magical girl and protector of all teenage girls. Join Sailor Moon and her talking cat in her sweet and romantic manga adventures!
book.book665.title: Ouran High School Host Club; Volume 1
book.book665.author: Bisco Hatori
book.book665.description: What awaits Haruhi, the poor girl at an expensive private school, when she suddenly has to work off a debt to some weird all-male after-school club? Well, first of all, she has to dress the part... A quirky and hilarious romance manga for young adults.
book.book666.title: My Lesbian Experience With Loneliness
book.book666.author: Nagata Kabi
book.book666.description: A very candid memoir in which the author shares her journey with mental health, sexuality, and growing up. A must-read for josei fans!
book.book667.title: Monster; Volume 1
book.book667.author: Naoki Urasawa
book.book667.description: The brilliant surgeon Dr Kenzo Tenma might be the only one who can find out the twisted motivations of a cold and calculating serial killer, in this tense and dark crime thriller in manga form.
book.book668.title: The Rose of Versailles
book.book668.author: Riyoko Ikeda
book.book668.description: This shojo manga is a historical romance classic. Alongside Marie Antoinette's life at Versailles and the brewing unrest among the French, we follow Lady Oscar, a noblewoman who lives as a man so she can command the palace guard.
book.book669.title: FAKE; Volume 1
book.book669.author: Sanami Matoh
book.book669.description: When Ryo becomes a detective in New York, he is partnered up with the American Dee, who soon reveals his feelings for Ryo. Fake is a lighthearted romantic comedy series for all BL manga fans with 90s nostalgia.
book.book670.title: Dickens at Christmas
book.book670.author: Charles Dickens
book.book670.description: Bah! Humbug! A collection of Dickens' famous Christmas tales, both heartwarming and spooky. This edition includes A Christmas Carol, The Chimes, A Cricket on the Hearth, Battle of Life, and the Haunted Man.
